scriptUpdates.reason: Reviewed migration deadline fix: four transactions per invocation, fresh sequential batches, local trace metadata, receipt-derived cutover baseline; no contract or economic config changes.

Reviewed first-batch cutover reconciliation: prove the first migration timestamp and transaction order, preserve exact actual debits and quote limits, recover the confirmed batch without broadcast. No contract or economic configuration changes.

Reviewed recovery for a canonically reverted first transaction with an unsent remainder: verify sender nonces, preserve failed calldata and quotes, enforce unchanged staking reserve/principal, then permit fresh quote execution. No contract, economic, slippage, or pool-limit changes.

Reviewed reserve-drift sizing fix: cap migration calls at 5% of live DTF custody instead of 25%; reconcile a successful prefix followed by a reverted transaction without replay. No deployed contract, fee, slippage, deadline, weight, or pool-limit changes.
